content: The treatment of symptomatic heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) has been evaluated in the EMPEROR-Preserved trial, which specifically investigated the effects of empagliflozin in this patient population. The trial demonstrated that empagliflozin significantly reduced the risk of hospitalizations due to heart failure. Additionally, it showed improvements in patients' overall health status, functional capacity, and the burden of symptoms associated with HFpEF. These findings underscore the therapeutic value of empagliflozin as an effective treatment option for individuals with HFpEF. The drug not only enhances the quality of life for these patients but also decreases their likelihood of requiring hospitalization for heart failure-related complications.
